cautions: This is a small selected sample for transparent illustration; it is not a polling average, exhaustive collection, forecast, or list of latest polls in every state.
Raw unweighted n does not encode design effects, house effects, nonresponse error, mode effects, turnout uncertainty or future campaign changes.

A reported interval usually applies to a single candidate proportion and is not the standard error of the difference between two candidates. For simple multinomial random sampling, SE(D-R) = 100 * sqrt((pD+pR-(pD-pR)^2)/n); real design and nonsampling uncertainty require additional treatment.
Do not use a normal-normal posterior as an election win probability without predictive future and systematic error and cross-race correlation.
A generic national ballot is a different outcome from state Senate candidate preference.
Respect poll question wording and whether leaners are included. Polls with different candidates or populations should not be silently pooled.
Polling absence is missing data, not a tied race or zero support.
A confidence or credibility interval crossing zero is not proof of a tied race; it indicates uncertainty under specified assumptions.
Round displayed margins to one decimal or whole points; more digits imply unjustified precision.
For Senate control with a 50-seat Republican threshold and 51-seat Democratic-caucus threshold, independent candidates require explicit caucus assumptions.
